method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows in the transition-state drawing. Count the six bonds around the carbon ring skeleton. Then add the two non-hydrogen substituent bonds shown on the right, C-O/OK and C-R. Do not add any implicit bonds to hydrogen or any arrow strokes. Total = 6 + 2 = 8.
